method: Complete reads of seven pinned blobs; Git and SHA256 identities verified. Ran one existing local exact-files regression; upstream tests and system account mutation were not run.
findings: Badlink test creates a temporary target then removes it and checks one broken-link row under follow/ignore/see modes, including type and path suffix. This is lint classification rather than content equality.

Bad-UID/GID test is module-skipped outside Linux/FreeBSD and returns without pytest.skip when non-root. Its helper prints and swallows failed account-management commands, so setup/teardown command failure does not immediately fail the test. It modifies system accounts in its upstream body; none executed here.

Nonstripped tests compile source through a shell command and early-return when feature unavailable. Positive test indexes the first record without asserting full record count. Executable-FIFO regression explicitly uses timeout=5 and asserts no records or counted files.

GUI import test performs no import or assertion when DISPLAY is unset. Tree tests require successful GUI import at module collection, cover ascending/descending size sorting with three trie entries and two model children, not duplicate detection or full UI behavior.
GUI helper checks Path GUI_DIR membership in sys.path but inserts str(GUI_DIR); repeated calls can insert repeated path strings. This is a source-level observation, not a measured GUI failure.

local_verification.scope: Current Unix host: replace one authored copy with FIFO at pre-hash checkpoint; retain exact healthy pair and Changed issue; second scan reports preexisting FIFO as NotRegular. Terminal completion observed; no universal timeout bound proven.

limits: No GUI runtime, upstream suite or account-management commands executed.
Review remains partial; skipped pHash/ASAN work untouched.
